doubts.reason: This conclusion is limited to the vendor evidence SOURCE.md names and the written vendored evidence. The source does not establish that every general Better Auth documentation page lacks examples; none is asserted or synthesized here as a Volter Identity response example.

evidence: ../twin-world/docs/contributing/architecture.md: Writing a life; What a judge rejects; Published examples; Screens; Who is on a screen
assessment: The full examples journey has zero steps. A recursive inspection of the vendored OpenAPI found five example keys, all beneath a schema field: four on the unserved send-verification-email operation and one WWW-Authenticate header field on device/code. Published examples explicitly excludes field examples. There is no response/content example, response example map, components example, x-oaiMeta example or spec/doc-examples.json. The pinned auth.ts, product.ts and index.ts publish implementation rules and response construction, not complete example request/response pairs. The empty file does not claim synthetic data as a vendor example; no padding, invented setup, unexplained mismatch or incorrect notReplayed reason exists.
